criteria.acceptance: Screenshots show a broad, tall, organic mound family with several substantial surrounding chamber buildings, not only one central mound. The chamber buildings are irregular and ant-like, not repeated symmetric pads.
criteria.nextAction: Build and frame large role-specific chambers around the landmark mound; prioritize asymmetry, spacing, and no entry arches.

criteria.acceptance: Multiple readable tunnel mouths, chamber openings, terraces, and entrances are visible at gameplay camera distance. Entrances are irregular excavated cuts, not freestanding arches.
criteria.nextAction: Cut larger dark openings and chamber faces into mound volumes, with grounded paths leading to them.

criteria.acceptance: A single central mound is not enough; surrounding role buildings must also read as substantial organic ant architecture.
criteria.nextAction: Block visual completion until surrounding buildings have mass, height, and entrances.

criteria.acceptance: Role buildings read as organic ant chambers with asymmetrical lobes, irregular silhouettes, non-mirrored entrances, and no temple/pavilion/arcade language.
criteria.nextAction: Rework satellite building generation into asymmetrical chamber-lobes; avoid identical circular pads and symmetric cones.

criteria.acceptance: Separate buildings have readable gaps/passages and do not visually collide or overlap. Shared berms and paths are allowed only when the individual chamber silhouettes remain clear.
criteria.nextAction: Adjust placement footprints, berms, and camera staging so role buildings stop overlapping and remain individually readable.
